name: Jane Street Programs
page_total_how: programs-endpoint.json is the list the programs-and-events page renders; 11 sessions had an apply form and a deadline still ahead on 2026-10-27 (most in London and Hong Kong).
notes: The programs (FTTP, FOCUS, INSIGHT, Bridge, SEE, …) are not Greenhouse posts: each session is applied for through a janestreet.com form, so the jane-street Greenhouse checker never sees them. The file also keeps past sessions, events without a form and high-school programs; only sessions taking applications are read.
